articles.title: Vintage Harmanpreet takes centre stage as India complete 3-0 series sweep in Raipur
articles.summary: India posted a mammoth 216 for seven before restricting Zimbabwe to 124 for seven in 20 overs to complete a 3-0 series sweep. Shafali Verma set the tone with an entertaining 69 off 37 balls, but it was Harmanpreet's return to her destructive best that gave the innings its defining flourish.

articles.title: Why is Centre reviewing National Mineral Policy, 2019? Critical minerals, recycling

articles.title: YSRCP vows to stay in Andhra local polls amid intimidation claims
articles.summary: Alleged attacks, intimidation and criminal cases will not force the YSRCP out of the ongoing local body elections in Andhra Pradesh, party state coordinator Sajjala Ramakrishna Reddy said on Tuesday, according to news agency Press Trust of India. Reddy also demanded an inquiry by a sitting High Court judge into the recent alleged police firing in Pulivendula.

articles.title: Foreign Banks Return to India With a ‘Buy, Don’t Build’ Strategy
articles.summary: Foreign lenders are increasingly choosing to buy established financial businesses in India rather than build banking operations from scratch, as large cross-border deals reshape competition in one of the world’s fastest-growing major economies. The trend has accelerated with Canada’s Fairfax Financial Holdings agreeing to acquire a majority stake in IDBI Bank for $5.

articles.title: 'Makes all the sense in the world to talk to them': Rubio on visit
articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is visiting India from October 20 to 22 to discuss energy cooperation. He will visit Reliance Industries' Jamnagar refinery in Gujarat, highlighting its refining capabilities. Rubio stated that energy is directly linked to national security during a media interaction in Mumbai. He expressed concerns about energy disruptions affecting global supply and economic stability.

articles.title: Albania Supreme Court attack sparks India political row over protests
articles.summary: Violent protests in Albania targeting government offices triggered a political row in India on October 20. The Bharatiya Janata Party accused opposition leaders of inciting anarchy after remarks about the unrest. Opposition politicians defended peaceful demonstrations and rejected foreign comparisons, while Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh chief Mohan Bhagwat warned that protests must remain within constitutional limits.

articles.title: PM Modi Performs Ravan Dahan in Delhi, Shoots Symbolic Arrow at Ravana’s Effigy

articles.title: Bastar's Rowghat in Chhattisgarh connects to rail network for the first time
articles.summary: “Beyond easing daily mobility for local communities, the expanded rail network is set to serve as an enduring socio-economic catalyst—galvanizing regional commerce, local industry, educational access, healthcare delivery, and employment opportunities across the state”, CM Sai said. articles.title: Romania Parliament Approves New Pro-European Government Led By Luca Niculescu
articles.summary: On Tuesday, the Romanian parliament approved a new government proposed by prime minister-designate Luca Niculescu. The vote ended months of political deadlock in the European Union and North Atlantic Treaty Organization member state. Niculescu secured 280 votes for his cabinet of Social Democratic Party ministers and technocrats. The new administration aims to stabilize the country amid ongoing regional security concerns.

articles.title: Dombivli GRP Arrests Man In Bihar 28 Years After Brother-In-Law’s Murder Over Divorce
articles.summary: Dombivli GRP has arrested Sandeep Krishnan in Bihar in connection with the 1998 murder of his brother-in-law, Shailesh More, allegedly over a divorce dispute. articles.title: Apple India's revenue more than doubles in 3 years, crosses ₹1 lakh crore
articles.summary: Apple India Pvt Ltd's revenue from operations crossed ₹1 lakh crore for the first time in FY26, rising 31% year on year to ₹1,03,853 crore. articles.title: Assam homestays under scrutiny after 24 foreign nationals apprehended
articles.summary: Guwahati, Oct 20: Homestays across Assam have come under scrutiny following the apprehension of 24 foreign nationals allegedly staying illegally in the country, with the police operation raising questions about visitor verification at accommodation facilities. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma said the foreign nationals were apprehended from different homestays across the state following specific intelligence inputs.

articles.title: India reaffirms commitment to inclusive, development-oriented global trade laws at 81st

articles.title: Former Jammu Kashmir-Cadre IPS Officer Dies in Chandigarh

articles.title: India is Attracting Capital, But is it Capturing the Value

articles.title_hinglish: kya rilayansa jiyo vaishvika niveshakon ke samane khuda ko eka praudyogiki diggaja ke rupa men pesha kara sakata hai?

articles.title: Gurgaon overshot annual PM10 limit in April, 22 Haryana cities cross benchmark

articles.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces mounting political and economic pressure across India
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces growing political fatigue, rising youth unemployment, and public protests across Indian urban centers. Opposition parties are demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over electoral concerns. Meanwhile, economic distress, declining consumer confidence, and strained foreign relations have intensified pressure on the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party government, exposing widespread public discontent and institutional friction.
articles.title_hi: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी पूरे भारत में बढ़ते राजनीतिक और आर्थिक दबाव का सामना कर रहे हैं

articles.title_hinglish: pradhanamantri narendra modi pure bharata men badhate rajanitika aura aarthika dabava ka samana kara rahe hain
articles.summary_hinglish: pradhana mantri narendra modi ko badhati rajanitika thakan, badhati yuva berojagari aura bharatiya shahari kendron men sarvajanika virodha ka samana karana pada raha hai। vipakshi dala chunavi chintaon ko lekara mukhya chunava aayukta jnyanesha kumara ko hatane ki manga kara rahe hain। isa bich, aarthika sankat, upabhokta vishvasa men giravata aura tanavapurna videshi sanbandhon ne sattarudha bharatiya janata parti sarakara para dabava badhaा diya hai, jisase vyapaka sarvajanika asantosha aura sansthagata gharshana ujagara huaa hai।

articles.title: Manipur violence kills 4; locals place bodies outside CM's house
articles.summary: In the first incident, violence erupted during a musical event in a locality inhabited by Meiteis and Pangal Muslims. A senior police official said that there were stone-pelting and gunfire. Several people were injured. A 24-year-old man later succumbed to bullet injuries. Officials said that villagers marched towards the CM's high-security bungalow in Imphal, carrying the bodies of the victims.

articles.title: Delhi Police transfers trespass case against political leaders to crime branch
articles.summary: On Monday, Delhi Police transferred a trespassing case involving Cockroach Janata Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das to the crime branch. The decision was announced hours after a court extended their custody. This move shifts the investigation to a specialized unit as authorities continue their proceedings regarding the incident in the capital.
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस ने राजनीतिक नेताओं के खिलाफ अतिक्रमण का मामला अपराध शाखा को स्थानांतरित किया

articles.title: Gujarat Police Innovation Challenge 2026: Winning teams awarded ₹18 lakh; focus
articles.summary: The valedictory ceremony of the ‘Gujarat Police Innovation Challenge 2026’ (Sentinel Hackathon 2026) concluded at i-Hub in Ahmedabad , marking a significant milestone in the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and CCTV infrastructure for public safety. The two-day event, described as India’s largest AI-CCTV hackathon, saw enthusiastic participation from innovators, startups, and researchers nationwide.

articles.title_hinglish: gujarata pulisa inoveshana chailenja 2026: vijeta timon ko ₹18 lakha ka puraskar; phokasa
articles.summary_hinglish: 'gujarata pulisa inoveshana chailenja 2026' (sentinala haikathona 2026) ka samapana samaroha ahamadabada ke aaee-haba men sanpanna hua, jo sarvajanika suraksha ke lie aartiphishiyala intelijensa (eaaee) aura sisitivi buniyadi dhanche ke ekikarana men eka mahatvapurna mila ka patthara hai। bharata ke sabase badaे eaaee-sisitivi haikathona ke rupa men varnita do divasiya karyakrama men desha bhara ke navapravartakon, startaapa aura shodhakartaon ki utsahapurna bhagidari dekhi gaee।

articles.title: Geothermal energy talks in Houston back US-India technology transfer and pilot projects
articles.summary: Senior US energy executives and Indian diplomats held a closed-door roundtable in Houston to speed up cooperation on next-generation geothermal energy. The meeting explored technology transfer, joint pilot projects, and investment options. Participants aimed to use Houston’s expertise in drilling, subsurface engineering, and oilfield services to support India’s clean energy transition.

articles.title_hinglish: amerika-bharata praudyogiki hastantarana aura payalata pariyojanaon ke samarthana men hyustana men bhu-tapiya oorja varta
articles.summary_hinglish: varishtha ameriki oorja adhikariyon aura bharatiya rajanayikon ne agali pidhaी ki bhu-tapiya oorja para sahayoga ko gati dene ke lie hyustana men eka banda kamare men golameja baithaka ki। baithaka men praudyogiki hastantaran, sanyukta payalata pariyojanaon aura nivesha vikalpon para vichara kiya gaya। pratibhagiyon ka lakshya bharata ke svachchha oorja parivartana ka samarthana karane ke lie driling, upasataha injiniyaringa aura tela kshetra sevaon men hyustana ki visheshajnyata ka upayoga karana tha।

articles.title: CJP Leaders Ashutosh Ranka, Sourav Das’ Trespassing Case Handed Over To Crime Branch
articles.summary: The CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have been extended till October 21 by a Delhi court on Monday. The two CJP leaders, who are lodged in Tihar Jail, were sent to five-day judicial custody on October 14 for allegedly violating their peace bonds and trespassing into Jantar Mantar, which was designated as a protest area.
articles.title_hi: सीजेपी नेता आशुतोष रांका, सौरव दास का अतिक्रमण मामला अपराध शाखा को सौंपा गया
articles.summary_hi: सीजेपी नेता सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका की सजा सोमवार को दिल्ली की एक अदालत ने 21 अक्टूबर तक बढ़ा दी है। तिहाड़ जेल में बंद दो सीजेपी नेताओं को कथित तौर पर शांति बंधन का उल्लंघन करने और जंतर-मंतर में अतिक्रमण करने के आरोप में 14 अक्टूबर को पांच दिन की न्यायिक हिरासत में भेज दिया गया था, जिसे एक विरोध क्षेत्र के रूप में नामित किया गया था।
articles.title_hinglish: sijepi neta aashutosha rank, saurava dasa ka atikramana mamala aparadha shakha ko saunpa gaya

articles.title: Delhi Police Crime Branch Takes Over Unauthorized Entry Case of CJP Leaders
articles.summary: The Delhi Police Crime Branch has taken over the unauthorized entry case involving Cockroach Janata Party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Sourav Das. A Delhi court extended their judicial custody until October 21 after they allegedly trespassed into Jantar Mantar and violated peace bonds while demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner. The next hearing is scheduled for October 21.
